Options:
  --hidden                          Search hidden files and directories
  -H                                Search hidden files and directories
  --no-ignore                       Include ignored paths
  -I                                Include ignored paths
  --type TYPE                       Select the entry type
  -t TYPE                           Select the entry type
  --extension EXT                   Select a filename extension
  -e EXT                            Select a filename extension
  --max-depth DEPTH                 Limit traversal depth
  -d DEPTH                          Limit traversal depth
  --exclude PATTERN                 Exclude a glob pattern
  -E PATTERN                        Exclude a glob pattern
  --full-path                       Match against full paths
  --absolute-path                   Display absolute paths
  --glob                            Interpret the search pattern as a glob
  --fixed-strings                   Interpret the search pattern literally
  --case-sensitive                  Match case sensitively
  --ignore-case                     Match without case sensitivity
  --print0                          Separate paths with NUL bytes
